steps.text: 請開元港港務人員教你看潮汐時鐘
steps.textEn: Ask the Kaiyuan Harbour staff to teach you the tide clock

lines.zh: 出海、下潮間帶前都要先看潮汐。
lines.en: Check the tide before going to sea or onto the tide flats.

lines.zh: 一天大約有兩次退潮。我把潮汐時鐘放在畫面上方，退潮的時候再去潮間帶。
lines.en: There are about two low tides a day. I've put the tide clock at the top of the screen — go to the tide flats at low tide.

toast: 畫面上方會顯示漲潮或退潮。現在先簡化成清晨與黃昏退潮。
toastEn: The top of the screen shows high or low tide. For now it's simplified to low tide at dawn and dusk.

hint.zh: 開元港的港務人員最懂潮汐。
hint.en: The Kaiyuan Harbour staff know the tides best.

text.whoEn: Tao woman; the traveller comes along
text.coop: 族女可單人；旅人參加要雙人：族女＋旅人
text.coopEn: The Tao woman can go alone; for the traveller to join, a pair: Tao woman + Traveller
text.unlock: 貝類、海藻卡（族語名待族人提供）、I3
text.unlockEn: Shellfish and seaweed cards (Tao names to come from the community), I3

steps.text: 退潮時，族女到朗島的潮間帶（旅人可以跟著去）
steps.textEn: At low tide, the Tao woman goes to the Iraraley tide flats (the traveller can come along)

lines.en: Low tide. The reef is showing.

lines.zh: 貝類、海藻的族語名稱還要請族人告訴我們，今天先用中文記下來。
lines.en: We still need the community to tell us the Tao names for shellfish and seaweed. Today we'll note them in Chinese.

hint.zh: 長輩問「海裡有什麼呢？」——意思是要你們退潮時去潮間帶看看。先看懂潮汐時鐘，再請族女帶路。
hint.en: The elder asked, "What's in the sea?" — meaning go look at the tide flats at low tide. Learn the tide clock first, then ask the Tao woman to lead the way.

steps.text: 退潮時，族女在潮間帶只拿需要的量（旅人可以跟著看）
steps.textEn: At low tide, the Tao woman takes only what she needs from the tide flats (the traveller can watch)

lines.zh: 這個太小了，放回去。夠煮一餐就好。
lines.en: This one's too small. Put it back. Enough for one meal is fine.
So you don't just pick up everything you see.

lines.zh: 只拿需要的，海才會一直有。
lines.en: Take only what you need, and the sea will always have more.

hint.zh: 退潮時去潮間帶，女性長輩說：只拿需要的。
hint.en: At the tide flats at low tide, the woman elder says: take only what you need.

text.whoEn: Tao woman; the traveller comes along
text.coop: 族女可單人；旅人參加要雙人：族女＋旅人
text.coopEn: The Tao woman can go alone; for the traveller to join, a pair: Tao woman + Traveller
text.seasonEn: Land crab season (to be confirmed), at night
text.pre: I2；可提早接，頭燈來自 S1
text.preEn: I2; can be taken early, headlamp from S1
text.unlock: 陸蟹卡、水煮陸蟹料理卡、C2
text.unlockEn: Land crab card, boiled land crab recipe card, C2
text.kindEn: Take early, needs an item + time of day

steps.text: 夜裡，族女帶著頭燈在朗島附近看看陸蟹（旅人可以跟著去）
steps.textEn: At night, the Tao woman takes a headlamp to look for land crabs near Iraraley (the traveller can come along)

lines.zh: 頭燈照到了，路邊有螃蟹在走。
lines.en: The headlamp caught one — there's a crab walking by the road.

lines.zh: 陸蟹的季節和規矩還要請族人確認，今晚先只看、不抓。
lines.en: The land crab season and its rules still need checking with the community. Tonight we only look, no catching.

hint.zh: 晚上路邊常看得到螃蟹，記得帶頭燈。
hint.en: You often see crabs by the road at night. Remember your headlamp.

name.en: Help land crabs cross the road

steps.text: 陸蟹季的晚上，騎車慢慢經過，停車護送陸蟹過馬路
steps.textEn: On land crab season nights, ride past slowly and stop to help land crabs cross the road

lines.zh: 停車！前面有陸蟹。慢慢走，不要用手抓。
lines.en: Stop! There's a land crab ahead. Go slowly, don't grab it.

lines.zh: 陸蟹季的夜晚，母蟹要穿過馬路到海邊釋放幼蟲。騎慢一點，就能少壓到一隻。
lines.en: On land crab season nights, mother crabs cross the road to release their young in the sea. Ride slower and you'll save one more.

toastEn: You helped land crabs cross the road safely.

hint.zh: 夏天的晚上，西岸路邊常有陸蟹過馬路，騎車要慢。
hint.en: On summer nights, land crabs often cross the west coast road. Ride slowly.

review: 陸蟹季（夏季夜間母蟹過馬路釋幼）的時間請族人或保育單位確認

name.en: The coconut crab you can't eat now

steps.text: 問長輩：晚上看到的椰子蟹能不能吃
steps.textEn: Ask the elder: can you eat the coconut crab you saw tonight?

lines.zh: 以前椰子蟹是會吃的。現在牠們少了，是保育動物，看到了也不能抓。
lines.en: People used to eat coconut crabs. Now there are fewer, and they're protected. Even if you see one, you can't catch it.
When there are more of them again, we'll see.

toast: 椰子蟹現在是保育動物，不能抓。
toastEn: Coconut crabs are protected now. No catching.

hint.zh: 晚上在路邊好像看到一隻好大的蟹……問問長輩。
hint.en: I think I saw a huge crab by the road last night… Ask the elder.

name.zh: 到椰油的雜貨店買頭燈
name.en: Buy a headlamp at the Yayo grocery store

steps.text: 到椰油的雜貨店買頭燈
steps.textEn: Buy a headlamp at the Yayo grocery store

lines.zh: 頭燈嗎？晚上走路用得到。電池也幫你裝好了。
lines.en: A headlamp? Handy for walking at night. I've put the batteries in for you.

hint.zh: 椰油的雜貨店什麼都有。
hint.en: The Yayo grocery store has everything.

name.zh: 到雜貨店買防曬與飲水
name.en: Buy sunscreen and water at the grocery store

text.unlock: 防曬（G3 需要，也降低曬傷機率）
text.unlockEn: Sunscreen (needed for G3, also lowers the chance of sunburn)

steps.text: 到雜貨店買防曬與飲水
steps.textEn: Buy sunscreen and water at the grocery store

lines.zh: 島上太陽很大，防曬和水都帶著。
lines.en: The island sun is strong. Bring sunscreen and water.

toast: 潮間帶撿貝類（G3）需要防曬。
toastEn: Picking shellfish on the tide flats (G3) needs sunscreen.

hint.zh: 椰油的雜貨店有防曬和水。
hint.en: The Yayo grocery store has sunscreen and water.

name.zh: 一次退潮撿 8 個貝類（太小的不撿）
name.en: Pick 8 shellfish in one low tide (leave the small ones)

text.whoEn: Tao woman; the traveller comes along
text.coop: 族女可單人；旅人同行要雙人：族女＋旅人
text.coopEn: The Tao woman can go alone; for the traveller to join, a pair: Tao woman + Traveller
text.pre: I3；可提早接，防曬來自 S2
text.preEn: I3; can be taken early, sunscreen from S2
text.unlock: 同一趟也算 I3、料理卡、糧倉
text.unlockEn: The same trip also counts for I3, recipe card, food store
text.kind: 提早接、道具卡關＋潮汐＋數量 8
text.kindEn: Take early, needs an item + tide + count 8

steps.text: 女性長輩帶族女退潮去撿貝類
steps.textEn: The woman elder takes the Tao woman to pick shellfish at low tide

lines.zh: 退潮了，帶上防曬和水。太小的不撿，夠吃就好。
lines.en: Low tide. Bring sunscreen and water. Leave the small ones; just enough to eat.

steps.text: 族女在潮間帶撿貝類（太小的放回去）
steps.textEn: The Tao woman picks shellfish on the tide flats (puts the small ones back)

lines.zh: 這四個夠大。小的放回石縫裡。
lines.en: These four are big enough. The small ones go back in the cracks.

steps.text: 趁潮水回來之前，再撿幾個
steps.textEn: A few more before the tide comes back

lines.en: …seven, eight. The tide is coming in. Back to shore.

lines.zh: 八個，大小都剛好。妳記得放小的回去，很好。
lines.en: Eight, all a good size. You remembered to put the small ones back. Good.

toast: 一次退潮撿了八個貝類。
toastEn: Picked eight shellfish in one low tide.

hint.zh: 退潮時，女性長輩會帶族女去撿貝類。記得先買防曬。
hint.en: At low tide, the woman elder will take the Tao woman to pick shellfish. Buy sunscreen first.
